title: SMP Templates - Adventure and Dungeons
description: Enhance your exploration and add some thrilling dungeons to your FabricMC server.
body:

### **The SMP Template series**

This series was made to create a structured packs for small server owners. It should be used to find inspiration or to use it as a base for SMPs.

### **General goal of this pack**

This pack is a collection of server-sided mods. It is aiming to give a refreshing and new vibe to minecraft to minecraft while staing vanilla friendly.

### **What this pack does:**
- Adding new biomes and enhancing the actual ones
- Adding structures to explore and challenges to face
- Packing up all the well-known optimization mods to maitain reasonable performance

### **What this pack is NOT adding:**
- No addition of NEW content like mobs or items. Server side has some limitations.
- No extra mods to enhance the GUI or Quality of Life. This is mostly done on client side.


**WARNING**
This pack was not made by an experienced modder but just a casual player. It is not meant to be played by thousands of players or used for some commercial use.

## **Mod list**

- **Lithium:** basic entity and mechanics optimization.
- **FerriteCore:** memory usage optimization
- **Krypton**: improved networking
- **Noisium:** improved noise terrain generation
- **CCME:** better chunk gen and loading
- **ModernFix:** general impovements
- **ScalableLux:** light engine improvements
- **Spark:** performance monitoring and reports
- **CCTOV:** new and improved villages
- **RoadArchitect:** roads between structures and villages
- **Qraftyfied: STRUCTURES:** new detailed and vanilla friendly structures
- **Unnamed Sea:** islands and structures to enhance the oceans
- **Dungeons and Taverns collection:** Enhance the exploration and combat with structures, taverns and overhauled vanilla structures
- **Blooming Biosphere:** new authentic biomes and vanilla biomes improvements
- **Improved village placement:** villages can spawn on flat and more natural places
